annotations.title: utilpeek: crypto Fear & Greed Index (value 0-100, label, last 7 days; alternative.me)

description: utilpeek: Get the crypto Fear & Greed Index: market sentiment value, label and 7-day history. For local exchange premiums use get_local_crypto_premiums. Returns the crypto Fear & Greed Index (alternative.me): value 0-100, label and the last 7 daily values, with source and attribution in the reply. One value per day from an hourly cache; the attribution to alternative.me must stay next to the data. No cache, or older than 3 days, is a 503 (not charged). Informational only, not investment advice. Typically under 0.1 s (served from the cache). Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/crypto-fear-greed-index-api.html
name: get_crypto_fear_greed_index

attribution.description: credit to alternative.me; carry it next to the data

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.

history_7d.description: newest first, one value per UTC day
